name: Abdou Yaackoubi
title: Senior Product Designer
tagline: Product direction, interface craft, and an AI-assisted build practice.
intro: What holds my attention is interaction design — how a thing responds, what it does while it waits, and how it recovers. I build to find out: a prototype in code answers questions a static frame cannot.
currently: Senior product designer at InstaDeep, across three AI products and the design system underneath.
contactLede: Senior product designer at InstaDeep. Open to conversations about product work and collaborations.
about: I started in UX/UI design in 2020. Since then I have worked across AI, fintech, food delivery, automotive retail, pharmacy and home services.

From October 2021 to November 2023 I was Chief Product Officer at Steer, leading a small team of front-end and back-end engineers while being the only person in design and product. The company went on to raise in France and is now based in Versailles.
I am now a senior product designer at InstaDeep, working on AI products — among them DeepPCB, their cloud-native PCB routing software, and the design system the company's product surfaces run on.

How I work changed over the last two years. I prototype in code rather than describing behaviour in a spec, and I run an AI-assisted build process end to end — this site is one of its outputs: a static site with its own generator, image pipeline and test suite, and no framework. Being able to build the thing I designed shortens the distance between an idea and knowing whether it works.
Outside of work I am obsessed with video games and enjoy the gym, and I cherish time with family and friends.
